source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the mean (PDF 189-191).

blocks.text: Mean, yaani ausat, markazi rujhan ka paimana hai jo data ki darmiyani qeemat deta hai. Hayatiyat mein yeh bare data ko aik aam qeemat mein samet'ta hai, jaise ausat size ya barhne ki raftaar. Ungrouped data ke liye mean = (sab qeematon ka jama) / n, jahan n qeematon ki tadaad hai. Grouped data ke liye mean = (fi x xi) ka jama / fi ka jama, jahan xi ith class ka midpoint aur fi us ki frequency hai.

Aik mahir ne park mein aik qisam ke paanch parindon ka wazan kiya: 400 g, 420 g, 470 g, 390 g aur 460 g. Qadam 1: wazan jama karein: 400 + 420 + 470 + 390 + 460 = 2140 g. Qadam 2: parinde ginein: n = 5. Qadam 3: taqseem karein: 2140 / 5 = 428 g. Ausat wazan 428 g hai.

Mukhtalif mitti wale qitaat ke paudon ki unchaiyan (cm) class intervals mein jama ki gayi hain. Qadam: classes tarteeb dein, har midpoint nikalein, har midpoint ko us ki frequency se zarb dein, hasil zarb jama karein, aur kul frequency se taqseem karein.

blocks.caption: Grouped data se paudon ki ausat unchai (kitab ka table)

blocks.text: Mean = 460 / 24 = 19.17 cm. Paudon ki ausat barhotri 19.17 cm hai.

items: Grouped mean = f x midpoint ka jama / f ka jama (paude: 460 / 24 = 19.17 cm).
